description: Change forge-delegate configuration at runtime — no reinstall. Only change settings when the user asks; never raise defaultModel to a premium tier on your own. Pass any subset of {defaultModel, defaultAgent, defaultVariant, autoApprove, timeoutMs, defaultDirectory, profiles}. Set a field to null to clear it. To edit a profile, pass the whole profiles object (e.g. profiles: {tests: {model: "..."}}); set a profile to null to delete it. Only provided keys change; others are preserved.

autoApprove.description: Let delegated agents edit files and run commands without asking

defaultAgent.description: opencode agent used when a call omits agent

defaultDirectory.description: Absolute project path used when a call omits directory

defaultModel.description: provider/model used when a call omits model

defaultVariant.description: Reasoning-effort variant, sent to opencode as provider/model#variant

profiles.description: The whole profiles object: { name: { model, agent, variant, autoApprove, directory } }. A profile set to null is deleted

name: set_delegate_config
